provenanceTimestampErratum.commitTimestampSource: git committer date of the introducing commit (git log --diff-filter=A), converted to UTC; author and committer dates are identical on every inspected commit

provenanceTimestampErratum.corroboration: two of the three erroneous values (14:05:00Z and 14:40:00Z) were also LATER than the actual shell UTC clock at the time this ratification was prepared, so they cannot have been true instants of anything
provenanceTimestampErratum.operativeChronology: for chronology and provenance the introducing Git commit timestamp is the operative, durable NO-LATER-THAN boundary for each record above; the historical recordedAtUtc values are retained verbatim as written and are not relied on
provenanceTimestampErratum.mechanism: classified by the owner as a timezone-conversion/formatting defect; this record asserts no finer mechanism than that
provenanceTimestampErratum.correctiveMeasureGoingForward: every instant written by this live window is read from the shell with date -u and checked against the actual clock before commit and against its introducing commit timestamp after commit

ownerConfirmationOfB17503a.statement: The owner confirms that the four decisions contained in b17503a are genuine owner decisions. The timestamp defect does NOT invalidate those decisions; it is metadata correction only.

reserveConsumptionSemantics.consumptionInstant: a reserve becomes CONSUMED when its valid canonical replacement-ledger row is (1) appended, (2) committed and (3) pushed to origin, BEFORE any institution network activity
reserveConsumptionSemantics.windowV1: all four rows (3->0, 4->1, 6->2, 8->3) are appended and pushed together before request #1, so reserve consumed = 4 before request #1; this is intentional

replacementFailureInsideTheWindow.effect: a new pending replacement obligation for the SAME slot, conceptually

continuationWindowThresholds.governingContract: the already-landed continuation-window gate (src/test/harness/phase2b2d/continuationWindow/windowGate.ts at 36bd531), accepted as-is; not modified
continuationWindowThresholds.P1: INVALID_ROOT_AUTHORITY on >= 3 consecutive completed work items within this window
continuationWindowThresholds.P2: robots blocked/unreadable on >= 3 consecutive items, OR strictly > 40% of the planned window size (3 of 5)
continuationWindowThresholds.P3: runTerminalState FAILED on >= 2 consecutive items, OR any ORCHESTRATION_ERROR immediately
continuationWindowThresholds.P5: raw page evidence < 4 on strictly > 30% of the planned window size (2 of 5)
continuationWindowThresholds.P7: any current generation/window invariant mismatch, immediately
continuationWindowThresholds.P8: any host-state anomaly during current live execution, immediately
